label: Generic page block storage
description: A declarative Directus storage envelope that dispatches validated data to existing approved renderers without creating one collection per component.
accessibility: The selected approved renderer retains its accessibility contract.
Unknown component keys fail closed and do not render.
Migration preserves block order, slots, headings, media alternative text, and publication status.
bespoke_gap: This is a storage and dispatch capability rather than a visual primitive; shadcn components remain selected by each approved renderer.

checks.reason: Slots are inside the tenant page-slot contract.
